A different standard

Built for transparency.

01

Probability first.

Every pick starts with an estimated chance of winning. We test whether the offered odds are worth the model's risk.

02

News changes the call.

Suspensions, injuries, rest and rotation can invalidate a promising number. A pick can be rejected even with positive EV.

03

Losses stay visible.

Selections are logged before kickoff. The archive keeps the original price, probability when the result arrives.

Behind each selection

Simple rules. No shortcuts.

1X2 only. We distinguish a daily featured favourite (highest carefully checked win probability) from a value pick (positive modelled EV after independent checks). We can publish zero value picks on a day.
